name: Gollum, Obsessed Stalker
oracle_text:
Skulk (This creature can't be blocked by creatures with greater power.)
At the beginning of your end step, each opponent dealt combat damage this game by a creature named Gollum, Obsessed Stalker loses life equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.
blocked_sentences: At the beginning of your end step, each opponent dealt combat damage this game by a creature named Gollum, Obsessed Stalker loses life equal to the amount of life you gained this turn.

needs.what: a player selector for 'each opponent dealt combat damage this game by a creature named <name>': a per-game ledger of seats dealt combat damage, keyed by the dealing creature's name (any object with that name, across zone changes and across turns), never cleared at end of turn
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The closest is the player spec dealt_combat_damage_by (not even in the packet reference), which reads TurnLedger.players_dealt_combat_damage_by / _by_subtype -- keyed by oid or subtype and cleared every turn, so it answers 'this turn' by 'self' or a subtype, never 'this game' by a card name. The condition combat_damage_by is likewise per-turn and subtype-only. life_gained_this_turn covers the amount and lose_life the effect; only the player set is missing.
